findings_summary: Independent adversarial review of the corrected main-protection ruleset artifact before it is applied to GitHub. Confirmed the payload no longer carries any bypass (bypass_actors == []), that the review-enforcement classification is correct and honest (single-member organization, no teams, no invitations, so required_approving_review_count 1 would permanently deadlock; classification REVIEW_ENFORCEMENT_TOOL_GAP), that the payload's top-level keys are exactly the set accepted by POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets, that all 14 required check contexts form a perfect bijection with the 14 PR-triggered CI job names and that no release/tag/Pages/dispatch-only job is required, and that the documentation agrees with the payload without claiming server-side review enforcement. No defect reproduced; verdict APPROVE.
